svg.title: Отведение ноги в сторону стоя — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing lateral hip abduction with own body weight, FRONT view. Athlete upright next to one slim support post and touching it lightly with the right hand. Right stance leg and post fixed. START both legs close together, left foot lightly off floor. FINISH straight left leg extends laterally toward image right at about 30 degrees, toes and hips still face camera, stable pelvis, no lean. No bands, cables, weights or ankle attachments. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
